quizName: DMV Practice Test #7 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: If your motorcycle chain or belt breaks, what will happen?

options.text: Power to the rear wheel will suddenly increase.
Power to the rear wheel will suddenly stop.
Power to the front wheel will suddenly stop.
Power to the front wheel will suddenly increase.

questions.correctAnswerText: Power to the rear wheel will suddenly stop.
questions.explanation: If your chain or belt breaks, the rear wheel will lose all power immediately.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should riders do?

options.text: Use only their mirrors to check for other vehicles.
Turn their head to look behind them for traffic.
Brake hard to let vehicles in their blind spot pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn their head to look behind them for traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots. Always turn your head to check for traffic before you change lanes.

questions.question: A good face shield should:

options.text: Give you a clear view to both sides.
Block all air from passing through it.
Be so tight that glasses cannot fit under it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give you a clear view to both sides.
questions.explanation: A face shield must have no scratches, resist damage, allow clear side views, fasten securely, allow air to pass through, and have room for glasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: A good face shield should NOT:

options.text: Allow clear views to both sides.
Block all air from passing through.

questions.correctAnswerText: Block all air from passing through.
questions.explanation: A good face shield must allow air to pass through. If it blocks all air, it will fog up and make it hard to see. A good shield should be scratch-free, show clear views, and fasten securely.

questions.question: Which protects your face the most?
questions.explanation: A plastic face shield protects your whole face during a crash. Goggles only protect your eyes. A windshield does not provide enough protection.

questions.question: Most crashes happen during the day. To be safer, you should:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors when riding to make yourself more visible to other drivers, even during the day.

questions.question: How can you tell if your rear tire has gone flat while riding?

options.text: You hear a hissing sound from the back of the bike.
The back end jerks from side to side.

questions.correctAnswerText: The back end jerks from side to side.
questions.explanation: If your rear tire fails, the back of your motorcycle will jerk from side to side. You usually will not hear the tire fail.

questions.question: When someone follows too closely behind you, you should:

options.text: Ignore them and focus on the road ahead.
Change lanes and let them pass.
Ride on the shoulder and let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Change lanes to let a tailgater pass. Speeding up makes it more dangerous. Never ride on the shoulder because other drivers will not expect you there.

questions.question: When riding at night instead of during the day, you should do all of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: Keep more space between you and other vehicles.
Use your high beam when possible.

questions.explanation: At night, ride slower, stay farther from other vehicles, and use your headlights. Never tailgate other vehicles at night.

questions.question: A rectangular sign usually tells you about:
questions.explanation: Rectangular signs with white background and black letters show traffic rules like speed limits. Follow the rules on these signs.

questions.question: Does making eye contact with another driver mean they see you?

options.text: Yes, it means they see you.
Yes, it guarantees they will let you go.
No, it does not mean they see you.
No, it is not worth trying.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it does not mean they see you.
questions.explanation: Do not rely on eye contact. A driver may look right at you and still not notice you. Never assume eye contact means they will let you go.

questions.question: What should you do to stop quickly?

options.text: Use the rear brake firmly, then slowly add the front brake.

questions.explanation: To stop quickly, use both brakes at the same time.

questions.question: What should riders do about their lane position?

options.text: Always stay in the same position.
Change positions often to stay alert.
Pick the position that gives you the most space around you.
Never ride in the center of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pick the position that gives you the most space around you.
questions.explanation: Road and traffic conditions change all the time. Choose the lane position that gives you the most space around you and lets other drivers see you best.

questions.question: What kind of attention does a motorcycle need?
questions.explanation: Small problems on a motorcycle are more serious than small problems on a car. Check your motorcycle thoroughly before every ride.

questions.question: What does a plastic face shield protect?

options.text: It is not needed if you have a windshield.
It does not protect as well as goggles.

questions.explanation: A plastic face shield protects your entire face in a crash. Goggles only protect your eyes. A windshield does not replace a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: How should a group of riders travel through a curve?
questions.explanation: Use a staggered formation normally. But switch to a single-file line when going through curves, making turns, or entering or leaving a highway.

questions.question: Which part of your body operates the gearshift lever?
questions.explanation: The gearshift lever is in front of the left footrest. You operate it with your left foot.

questions.question: How can you be seen better at an intersection?

options.text: Make eye contact with other drivers.
Ride close to the vehicle in front of you.

questions.explanation: Use your headlight and pick a lane position that lets oncoming traffic see you best. Keep space between you and other vehicles so you can move if needed. Do not rely on eye contact alone.

questions.question: What color are warning signs?

options.text: Yellow with black lettering or symbols.
Blue with white lettering or symbols.
White with black lettering or symbols.
White with red lettering or symbols.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow with black lettering or symbols.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell you about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: Why is a flat front tire especially dangerous?

options.text: The front tire powers the bike, so you lose speed.
The shaking makes it hard to see in your mirrors.

questions.explanation: A flat front tire is dangerous because it affects your steering. If your front tire goes flat while riding, safely get off the road as fast as you can.

questions.question: Where is the clutch lever usually located on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: The clutch lever on a motorcycle is usually on the left handgrip.

questions.question: Which item does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Good protection includes a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots or shoes that support your ankles, and gloves made of durable material. A baseball cap does not provide adequate head protection.

questions.question: What kind of pants provide the best protection for a motorcycle rider?

options.text: Pants that are loose and flap in the wind
Short pants that expose some leg

questions.explanation: Wear pants made of leather or sturdy synthetic material that cover your entire legs. Your clothing should fit snugly so it does not flap in the wind, but loose enough to allow movement.

questions.question: Where is the horn button usually located on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Know the location of all your motorcycle's controls before you ride. The horn button is usually located next to the left handgrip.

questions.question: Which factor does NOT affect a person's blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) depends on the amount of alcohol consumed, how fast it is consumed, and body weight. Height does not affect BAC.
